purpose: Repair only the proven production Web server API-origin runtime defect through the existing outbound-only restricted pc-prod controller, avoiding unavailable hosted-runner inbound SSH while preserving the production security boundary.
acceptance: The implementation changes only the authorized workflow, controller core, bounded local repair script and this scope file.
The owner command resolves exact current main before the restricted self-hosted production runner executes.

The pc-prod runner remains non-root, outside the Docker group and without direct Docker authority; root execution remains only through the existing /usr/local/sbin/pc-tai-release-controller sudo boundary.
The installed controller wrapper and sudoers authority are not modified or widened.
The controller accepts the repair only as a source-controlled special deploy submode and executes the exact current-main repair script from the protected repository.
If Web API_URL is already canonical or absent, the repair proves internal anonymous /auth/me and /staff/capabilities/me return 401 and performs no mutation.

If and only if the active Web API_URL is invalid, the repair may create or reuse the exact minimal Compose override setting web.environment.API_URL=http://api:3001 and recreate Web only with --no-deps --no-build --pull never.
The Web image and application revision remain unchanged; API and every non-Web container remain unchanged.
Any post-mutation failure restores the previous override state and recreates Web using the original configuration before reporting failure.
No database, migration, credential, password, TOTP, session, user, role, membership, DNS, Caddy, SSH-pin, image-build, image-pull or non-Web runtime mutation occurs.
Only sanitized bounded evidence is published; no secret, API origin value, protected path, Compose project, container ID or raw log is published.
